Tattoo - Starfield Dots.description:
🖋️ Tattoos: Starfield Dots
Scattered dot-work resembling a star map or constellation — small points of ink arranged across a section of skin.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Tattoo - Starfield Dots.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: A compact decorative scatter of dots with a few fine connecting lines on a visible shoulder or upper arm. It is a personal imagined star pattern, not an astronomical chart or a claimed sacred constellation.

Visual selection only: fit it to compatible visible surfaces; never invent limbs, horns, ears or other anatomy. Keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features. It adds no Quirk effect, item, protection, license or history.
